apiContracts: GET /api/omni/status returns one stable representative per normalized connector base URL.
Registry seeding is idempotent for sequential repeated requests even without relying on a unique database index.
POST /api/admin/connectors accepts only an allowlisted HTTPS origin and rejects a normalized duplicate with HTTP 409.
New administrator-created connectors remain disabled and pending until rights evidence or terms are reviewed.
dataEntities: Reuses the existing connectors, import_jobs and connector_events entities; no new table or migration.

migrationPlan.canonicalEntityReuse: The existing connectors table and its base_url field remain canonical.
migrationPlan.backwardCompatibility: Existing duplicate rows remain stored. Public status projects one canonical row per normalized URL; the existing administrator cleanup endpoint remains the explicit repair mechanism.
migrationPlan.rollbackOrForwardRepair: Revert the Worker and regression test. No schema rollback or production data mutation is required.

privacySecurity.rateAndSizeLimits: Connector base URLs must be allowlisted HTTPS origins without credentials, paths, queries or fragments; duplicate normalized URLs are rejected.

integration: OmniPortal status projection and administrator connector-create route source checks.

stagingSteps: Review status projection and rights-pending behavior.
Deploy only through the separately approved production release process.

rollback.codeRollback: Revert the Worker connector registry changes and regression test.
rollback.dataRollbackOrForwardRepair: No database changes are made. Existing duplicate rows remain available for explicit administrator cleanup.
monitoringSignals: Repeated GET /api/omni/status calls do not increase seeded registry row count.
Public connector status contains one row per normalized base URL.
New connectors remain pending until evidence review.

collisionReview.duplicateRoutes: No route signatures are added or removed; existing OmniPortal and administrator connector routes receive stricter behavior.
collisionReview.sharedSurfaceOwners: Worker behavior remains owned by platform-kernel; regression test by platform-quality; package script by repository-operations; architecture records by platform-architecture.

changeSummary: Prevents repeated OmniPortal registry seeding from creating duplicate rows, deduplicates public status, rejects duplicate administrator connector creation and keeps new connectors pending until rights review.
acceptanceCriteria: Repeated registry seeding uses a normalized NOT EXISTS guard.
Public status returns one stable representative per normalized base URL.
Administrator connector creation validates an allowlisted HTTPS origin and rejects normalized duplicates.
New connector records are disabled and pending until rights evidence or terms are reviewed.
The regression test is included in the build command.
The exact PR head passes architecture, route, schema, build and Graphify validation.
